references.role: Only exact edit target: user-liked gargoyle head, mane/blindfold, massive body, two-arm/two-leg crouched anatomy, original sword, pose, armor, materials and rendering preserved; back/wing scale apparatus redesigned.

visual_qa.body_preservation: Roaring fanged stone gargoyle, sculpted curl mane, gold blindfold, hunched heavy torso, two actual claw arms and two crouched legs, planted free claw, single low diagonal star-hilt sword and navy/gold star robe family retained.
visual_qa.scale_readability: One large clearly visible central star bearing above spine, one tilted wing-shaped beam, a short mechanical indicator, and exactly two large deep bronze pans. Loaded left pan hangs low with star-carved stone weight; empty right pan is high. Three-chain pan suspension and beam-end eyelets visible. Scale reads strongly at thumbnail size.
visual_qa.integration: Both navy-inlaid stone wing arms form one balance beam on the central spine bearing, rather than two independent tiny wing-tip ornaments. Shoulder/spine attachment readable behind mane.
visual_qa.framing: Whole assembled hero, indicator, beam ends, both bowls and chains, sword tip, claws and feet fit in1536x1024. Outer right pan and upper apparatus margins are close but not cropped.
visual_qa.limits: Single-view candidate, not a final selection or 3D mesh/rig validation.
